messages:
eva: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 5xx and timeouts hitting the hosted API starting ~09:04 UTC. Telemetry shows a jump in gateway 502/504 from 0.3% -> 8% after this morning's canary.

matt: seeing the same in dashboards. Canary slice 7 (deploy: kernelpath-v2, flag: enable-prefetch-v2=true) correlated with increased error rates.

sanjay: logs show repeated: `upstream read timeout` and `503 downstream service: kvcache` from edge-proxy. Sample request IDs: `req_9a1c`, `req_9a2f`, `req_9a81`.

laura: customer support: ticket #CS-8421, client reported generation failing with 502 and long latency >8s. They're on dedicated plan but routed through hosted gateway.

eva: rolling up details for oncall. Can we confirm whether the canary config was scoped namespace-only? I think a selector accidentally applied globally.

matt: looks like the feature flag was marked `global=true` in the deploy manifest. That would explain cross-slice bleed.

sanjay: repro steps I ran locally: flip flag to true -> run load against canary tag -> within 60s errors climb. Revert flag -> errors fall back to baseline. Repro is repeatable on staging with identical kernelpath.

ops-bot: Incident runbook triggered: `inc-serve-5xx` created, pager duty notified, runbook link https://intranet/runbooks/serve-5xx

support-agent: I'm replying to CS-8421: "We're investigating a transient service error and will update shortly."

eva: immediate mitigation options? rollback canary rollout to 0%? toggle flag to false globally? prefer a scoped rollback so we don't impact other changes.

matt: safest: set canary slice weight to 0 and mark rollout paused. I'll prepare the rollback patch now.

sanjay: if the flag flip is global then toggling it off will mitigate quicker; but need to coordinate with infra so the change doesn't conflict with scheduled deploys.

laura: coordinating with customer — do we have ETA for mitigation? They asked for 30m window.

eva: aim for 15-20m. matt, can you push the rollback? Notify me once done.

matt: pushing `kubectl apply -f rollout-patch-canary-0.yaml` now. Command output: ```deployment "inference-gateway" patched
condition met: canary weight -> 0%```

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline note: `canary-weight-change` triggered by matt at 09:18 UTC. CI checks passed.

sanjay: telemetry: errors falling. 5xx now 1.2% and trending down. Latency medians back to baseline.

support-agent: Updated CS-8421: "We rolled back the canary flag and are monitoring. Please try your requests again and share a failing request id if any persist."

laura: customer replied: "requests succeeded after 10m, thanks — will reopen if anything else." :thumbsup:

eva: postmortem actions (short): 1) add guardrail to prevent global=true in canary manifests, 2) add automated canary telemetry alert for >2% 5xx within 5m window, 3) doc for support to correlate request-id -> canary-slice.

matt: I'll open an RFC for the guardrail and submit a follow-up PR to the deploy templates.

sanjay: I'll add a Playbook step to quickly run `kubectl patch` to set canary weight and a small CLI helper `ri-canary-status` to map weights -> slice ids.

eva: thanks team. Closing incident thread once postmortem is linked.

ops-bot: Incident `inc-6141592653` resolved by eva at 09:35 UTC, severity: P2, duration: 31m. Postmortem task created: PM-547
